hero.heading: Ceramic Coating in Boulder City, NV
hero.intro: How many weekends do you want to spend hand-waxing a car in Southern Nevada heat, only to watch the shine dull again within a month? Ceramic coating is a liquid polymer bonded to your paint by hand that leaves a hydrophobic, high-gloss finish so water and dirt slide off instead of baking on, with a shine that holds for years instead of weeks. It is built for drivers across Henderson and Las Vegas who want their car to look detailed every day, not just after a wash. We use DuraSlic DS 1500 Xtreme, and the car is usually with us two to four days, because the paint has to be decontaminated and corrected first, and we keep it a further 24 hours after application while it cures.
